I like knowing how things work underneath. So far that's meant a **[CPU ray tracer](https://github.com/pratikphophaliya/ray-tracer-cpp)** and a **[spinning ASCII donut](https://github.com/pratikphophaliya/rotating-donut)** in C++, a **[pixel-animal screensaver](https://github.com/pratikphophaliya/ascii-animals-screensaver)** for Windows, a **[Codeforces note-taking extension](https://github.com/pratikphophaliya/NoteForces)**, and a **[risk engine for India's crude oil supply](https://github.com/pratikphophaliya/Krude)**.
